pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, dark brown patches with highly irregular, serrated edges exhibiting sharp angularity and finger-like projections. Spatial area is greater on the neck, fragmenting into smaller, more complex polygons on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored interstitial pathways. Pathways are thin with frequent junction nodes, primarily Y-shaped, maintaining relatively consistent pixel width across the visible torso.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, dark mane along the dorsal neck with a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette against the desaturated background.
